backends.notes: Served with llama-server, which exposes an OpenAI-compatible API. Recipes use GGUF checkpoints and name the exact GGUF file; split checkpoints point to the first shard. Native launch recipes are supported on Linux and Windows.

recipes.security: Evaluation configuration only. Host networking exposes vLLM on host interfaces; use a firewall or reverse proxy, a scoped read-only HF token, and an isolated cache. For production, pin tested image, model, and code revisions.

runtime.label: Container
runtime.setup_command:
docker run --rm -it \
  --gpus all \
  --ipc host \
  --network host \
  --shm-size=16g \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 \
  --ulimit stack=67108864 \
  -e HF_TOKEN=$HF_TOKEN \
  -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface \
  --entrypoint /bin/bash \
  vllm/vllm-openai:v0.28.0

serve.label: Launch
serve.command:
vllm serve nvidia/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8000 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --attention-backend flashinfer \
  --moe-backend marlin \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.5 \
  --max-model-len 262144 \
  --max-num-seqs 8 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
  --enable-chunked-prefill \
  --async-scheduling \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3,"moe_backend":"triton"}' \
  --load-format fastsafetensors \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3 \
  --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice

clients.python:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:8000/v1", api_key="EMPTY")
resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="nvidia/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)

prerequisites: A Windows build of llama.cpp commit 7316c32d4f241820a5a4e12582f0f0b2b04938a7 providing llama-server.exe.
limitations: Validated only with the 8K SPEED-Bench throughput workload, concurrency 1, 256 generated tokens, and 15 measured requests.
Performance was measured with a 40,960-token server context; the launch command uses a 65,536-token context.
